title: Mentor Recruiting Influence Graph
description: Two outreach channels the club already uses, four it does not, and the question of which single new connection would reach the most new people.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI Agents for Registration, Scheduling, and Communication

educational.audience: Club leaders planning mentor and student recruitment beyond the school community

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a sample influence graph of a local community, the learner examines it to identify under-reached populations of mentors and students.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-explore influence graph with population estimates and a leverage-reveal button
pedagogical.assessment: Given two candidate channels of different sizes and addressability, ask which to approach first and why.
